prompt:
Generate an ORIGINAL academic textbook illustration. Design the composition yourself from scientific content, not from any existing textbook figure. The attached images are newly selected external OpenStax anatomy references ONLY for anatomical facts, not layout/style. Output ONLY UNLABELED PNG artwork on a genuinely transparent canvas. No letters, numbers, captions, formula marks, pseudo-text, watermarks, header/footer/title. Reserve useful clear blank areas adjacent to key anatomical components for later typesetting. Flat clean 2D biological diagram, fine outlines, readable mechanisms, generous whitespace. No 3D, shadow, gloss, texture, paper grain, waves, mottling, noise, stripe, gradients. Every colored region is a spatially constant SOLID fill. Main palette Blue #7B95C6, Cyan #49C2D9, Green #67A583, Peach #FFC1A6, Rose #C85E62, dark ink #3B4252; use pale uniform tints with white. No decorative icon cards. Anatomy can have simple fine anatomical contour lines but no decorative shading.
CONTENT: a multipolar neuron and a small three-neuron circuit. One clearly dominant central neuron: branching dendrites entering a soma with nucleus, a single axon leaving it, segmented myelin with exposed Ranvier nodes, distal axon splits into two branches, each presynaptic terminal contacts a distinct postsynaptic target neuron across a visible small synaptic gap. Exactly THREE neuron somas total: main one and TWO distinct target cells. Flow travels from central soma down its axon toward both terminals/targets. If you indicate direction, use simple neutral small arrows outside anatomy. Do not depict target cells fused into central axon or its myelin. In the CNS, myelin is supplied by oligodendrocytes; do not add a Schwann-cell nucleus to every myelin segment. Keep mechanism recognizable rather than photoreal. Leave natural margins for labels dendrites, soma, nucleus, axon, myelin, Ranvier node, terminals, synapse. No need for cellular micro-detail or extraneous organelles. Wide landscape canvas; choose original balanced geometry.
reference_policy: No original/previous project images provided. External OpenStax references only.

style_refinement_history.change: low-saturation palette and bounded actual-font typography

selected.prompt: Edit reference1 ONLY by replacing the colors with the muted palette below and rounding ordinary module rectangles. Preserve the EXACT original canvas, component positions, margins, scale, all shapes, all grids and their row/column counts, node counts, every connector, arrow direction and line endpoints. Do NOT redesign or reflow anything. Reference2 is ONLY the palette/reference finish; never copy its topology. Current figure is neural-biological-neuron, original canvas 1536×1024px. Main representations, networks, states, ordinary outputs and computation blocks should be blue; green only auxiliary inputs/alternate branch, yellow only gates/selection/position, red only loss/errors/gradient correction, purple only a needed additional category. Distinct classes retain distinguishable muted colors. Natural photographic examples and anatomy colors retain their scientific meaning. Do not add text or symbols that were not in the reference. Style: exact white opaque canvas; flat 2D technical drawing, no gradients, textures, shadows, pseudo text, numbers or letters. Rounded rectangle modules (6 px corner radius), neutral dark wires #556170. Blue priority #7188A3 with fill #E5EAF0 for the main mechanism; muted green #829C8B fill #E8EEE9 only secondary sources; muted yellow #B4A16F fill #F1ECDD for position/selection; muted red #A7787D fill #F0E5E6 only losses/errors, not the generic output; purple #9588A5 only a further category if needed. Most area white, fills pale and uniform. Draw all shapes, actual mechanism glyphs, matrices and connectors, leave labels empty for real-font typography.
